title: A question to the agent, answered in the same turn
expected: The answer is the work: nothing is unaddressed and the agent asked the user nothing.

steps.user: Why is the CI build so slow lately? Don't change anything, just tell me.

steps.agent: The build got slower because the e2e job stopped using the dependency cache on 3 November: the cache key includes the lockfile hash, and the lockfile now changes on every run. Install went from 40 seconds to about 6 minutes. I have not changed anything.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the user asked the agent, not the other way round
the finding is recorded as what the agent did
where things stand names the finding
